_why: UX2 B1–B4: every pre-order href (ux2/pre-order-hrefs.json) that the rebuilt surfaces no longer render within two taps of / is listed here as RELOCATES (to: a destination within two taps; selector: the control on that page when the destination is a control rather than a page) or RETIRED (why). check_ux2_education.cjs fails on a lost href not listed, on a listed destination that is not itself within two taps, and on a listed loss that is in fact still reachable (a stale entry) — so an href is added here only when the part that retires it lands, never ahead of time. check_audience_discovery.cjs reads the keys of `relocated` for chrome destinations. Nothing typed into a gate; UX2_LEDGER.md is the human record of the same table and also names destinations for hrefs that are still rendered elsewhere today.
